scope: Implement the approved Characters dossier and Controls manual designs. No new routes, service control, deployment or Git changes.

implementation.data: Existing two Guide JSON files remain the single source of character and control content.
implementation.characters: Four first-screen profile cards, one spoiler notice, character dossiers, relationship diagram, protagonist customisation and compact voice credits.
implementation.controls: Four first-screen input cards, illustrated dialogue and doll-work tasks, contextual QTE key diagrams, save/retry sequence, troubleshooting and version notes.
implementation.images: Existing original game media reused; AI-generated concept sheets are not rendered by either page.
implementation.unchanged: Navigation, TDK, Endings data/tree, homepage layout, iframe configuration and additional-game records.

verification.serverHtml: All prose and section anchors present in production HTML, with no collapsed sections. Checked by scripts/audit-notebook-topics.mjs.
verification.layout: Both pages have no document horizontal overflow, no first-screen card overlaps, one H1 and valid local anchor destinations at all four widths.
verification.navigation: Desktop and mobile Characters-to-Controls links produce Document requests, not client route swaps; browser back restores Characters. Mobile doll-work anchor verified.
verification.productionRuntime: Not started; visual checks used the user's existing development service on localhost:3002.

sources.use: Official shortcuts, bell menu, opening premise, customisation, platforms, warnings and voice credits.
Difficulty selection introduced in official 1.0.1; not proof of the iframe build.

limitations: No complete current-iframe input test across every minigame or device. Official shortcuts are contextualised rather than claimed as exhaustively tested in the embed.
No invented character ages, numeric affection thresholds or unconfirmed touch mappings.
QTE diagrams are instructional HTML keycaps, not fabricated gameplay screenshots.
Existing media republication permissions still require review before public launch.
